rows.en: You've got potential.
I'll show you the power of the Skull Leader!
To think you'd beat us!
rows.notes: Row 10883: object/tone unclear (taunt vs. surprise); read as surprise at being beaten.

rows.en: Let's see how much you've improved.
You've improved quite a bit.
I'm not losing to you lot yet, greenhorns!
S.M.S. Skull Squadron leader Ozma Lee to New U.N. Forces units. We're taking over this sector.
rows.notes: Transcript has kanji for 'middle region' (chuuiki), read as 'space area' (chuuiki, other kanji); name heard as Ozumarii, read as Ozma Lee.

rows.en: Let's protect the city!
Ranka, what are you doing in a place like this?
You there, amateur! Explanations later! Take that girl and get out of here, now!
Put so much as a scratch on her and I'll vaporize you with a reaction weapon.
That's not Gilliam! It's an amateur!
rows.notes: Pilot of the plane is unknown, so no pronoun; "Gilliam" per glossary (Henry Gilliam).

rows.en: Delta 1! I've got the Vajra pinned near the ship! Requesting covering fire!
rows.notes: "Delta 1" call sign taken as heard; not in glossary.

rows.en: Michael, Luca, I can only hold them so long here. Can you two handle it?
I'll buy you a drink later.
Skull Leader to all units. It's a mock battle, but don't slack off.
That's why I told you not to let your guard down! Skull Leader, joining the fight now!
rows.notes: Heard "Sukaraman" (call sign) and "mokusen" (not a word); read as Skull Leader and "joining the battle".

rows.en: Listen up. I won't let a single one of you die. We're all going back alive to Frontier.
All units, Planet Dance!
Skull 3, Luca! Don't overextend!
rows.notes: Heard "desugirna"; read as "desugiruna" (don't get ahead of yourself).

rows.en: Luca's been eaten by the enemy!
No! That ship captured Luca and swallowed him up!
Stop! What can you do on your own!
Skull Leader to all units, commence attack!
What!?
We strike first and flush the Vajra out! Let's go!
Could it be... really...
Do you still remember how to make that pineapple cake?
rows.notes: Heard "pine cake"; cake name taken as pineapple cake; addressee unknown, so "you".

rows.en: What of it!?
As long as a shred of will to fight remains, I'll fight!
Stop me if you can! You think you can beat me in a makeshift refit like that?
rows.notes: Heard "tometake tomete miro yo"; read as "tometakerya tomete miro yo" (stop me if you can).

rows.en: Alto!
This is the best way to protect the women who matter to me.
Sorry, but I'm not a grown-up,
I'm a man!
Alto! What are your wings for!?
rows.notes: Heard "soutome Aruto"; a word before Alto's name is garbled and dropped.

rows.en: I won't let you do as you please any longer! Not to Ranka, not to the Vajra!
That is...
All units, let's go! Totsugeki Love Heart!
Go, Alto!
I'll buy you some candy as a reward later, Luca.
I'm Ranka Lee. Nice to meet you!
I'm not sure I can support you, but I'll do my best!
I can't believe I took on a job as big as support!
I feel really out of place here.
Ugh, I'm getting so nervous!
Life is one, two, Deculture! Go for it, me!
You can do it! Definitely!
Let's do our best! I'm cheering for you too!
Let's do this gorgeously!
It's too dangerous to go on! Get away!
Are you okay? You look like you're hurting.
Geez! You're way too reckless!
What? No way!
Bail out! Hurry!
It's because I don't have the power...
Thanks for the reinforcements! I'm so happy!
Thank you for coming to help!
Now I can relax a little.
Yay! Deculture is the best! Kira!
We succeeded, right? Thank goodness!
I was a little useful too, right?
Hmph! Don't treat me like a kid!
I won't lose!
I'd rather go all in and crash than regret it!
Oh, yes!
I'll do my best!
Understood.
Is the Captain okay?
Hang in there, Captain!
Captain, this is dangerous at this rate!
No way! The Captain got shot down!
Captain!
It's my fault the Captain...
As expected of the Captain!
The Captain's so cool!
rows.notes: Heard "kaichou-san" (chairman); read as "taichou-san" (captain) like the neighbouring clips.

rows.en: Wow, wow! Amazing, Alto!
Big brother, you were so cool!
Everyone, hold me tight! To the ends of the galaxy! Kira!
Everyone, hold me tight! To the ends of the galaxy!
